environment.description: IoT edge gateway running on EC2 instance with IAM role 'iot-gateway-role'. The role has dynamodb:PutItem permission on the table 'iot-device-messages' with no condition keys restricting which partition key values can be written. The process runs as root with no seccomp profile, allowing any process in the container to send signals. Multiple device handler processes share the same PID namespace.

config.runtime: ECS container, shared PID namespace, no seccomp, CAP_KILL granted
config.network: VPC with DynamoDB VPC endpoint, no additional controls
